SBL_GlobalPrompt: Outputs reusable positive and negative prompt strings.
SBL_Resolution: Provides resolution presets, aspect-ratio groups, custom dimensions, and multiple-of snapping.
SBL_MathEvaluator: Evaluates mathematical expressions and multi-line math programs with numeric outputs.
SBL_Seed: Outputs a seed and ComfyUI noise object with a frontend randomize control.
SBL_Qwen2512ResT2I: Provides preset text-to-image resolutions for Qwen 2512 image generation workflows.
SBL_ZiTResT2I: Provides preset text-to-image resolutions for ZiT image generation workflows.
SBL_MathScratchpadNode: Interactive multi-line mathematical scratchpad with variables, functions, loops, comprehensions, and displayed output.
SBL_YuE2Instrumental: Converts a YuE2 ABC score to instrumental-only music by silencing Vocal notes while preserving timing and chords, generating section-only lyrics from ABC comments, and calculating a safe maximum duration from meter, tempo, and instrumental bar count. Outputs abc, lyrics, and max_duration for YuE2 Generate Music.
